drafted_from: tool:measure-source-coverage's own row (its words and input schema), the folder README and what read-data/source-coverage.mjs answered here for a synthetic source
start_here: Say to your AI: "Measure which pieces of source:synthetic have no step yet", giving its sources, pieces and steps readbacks. It runs tool:measure-source-coverage and answers every uncovered piece, stale pin and broken link by id.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it measures the source, piece and step readbacks you hand it and writes nothing.
instructions: 1. Read back the sources (id, BLAKE3 1f: identity, optional text), their pieces (exact text, identity, location) and the steps that cite them (came_from, source_versions).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:measure-source-coverage and { sources, pieces, steps }.
3. Read ok and gaps: each gap names its kind (uncovered, stale_step_source, stale_piece_source, invalid_no_check) with the source, piece and step ids.
4. Write a step for each uncovered piece, or give it a no_check reason pinned to its identity, and measure again until ok is true.

worked_examples.title: A source piece with no step is reported as uncovered
worked_examples.ask: Which pieces of my synthetic source have no step?
worked_examples.given: One source "Return the version.\nA story.", one piece "Return the version." at synthetic.txt:1, and no steps.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answered ok false with gaps [{"kind":"uncovered","source_id":"source:synthetic","piece_id":"piece:one","location":"synthetic.txt:1"}], with_step 0 and with_reason 0.
